A.title: THE CLEAR PANE
A.what: the doors as plain good glass: a sky-lit top fading down the pane, two upright glints, a steel push bar at the waist and a steel kick plate; every edge, rock, tree and bank as dictated

B.title: THE READOUT
B.what: the doors as dark screens (the world as the running machine it is): night-blue glass with three lit scan lines and a cursor block, a lit status line at the foot

C.title: THE MANIFESTATION
C.what: the doors as glass with the frosted safety band real glass doors carry at eye height (a white band of dots, so no one walks into it), a steel kick plate below

tree.title: the thin tree's crown (FOUR ISLAND's garden, BRAZEN)
tree.look: dictated: every tree's crown (gbageneral m_bush, gbatrees' crown in little) -- lobes lit across their tops, dark at their feet, a deep edge; symmetric, so its two halves meet

lip.title: the islet's rim corners (ROUTE 12, the islands)
lip.look: dictated: pass 3's crenellated lip on 239 between them, carried on in phase to where the rim turns down

ground.title: the sand's corner, the forest path's edge, a cliff sliver
ground.look: dictated, and already met: each is all edge -- the halo band and the sand's lip (4), the path's scalloped edge its sides share (301), a cliff's grey rim and rock line beside a bridge (503, 6 draws) -- so ours is vanilla's; redrawing them is redrawing every path edge

rock.title: the sea rock (every sea route; BREATHVERSE in PALLET's row 10)
rock.look: dictated: the chunky stones of its twin already in the water strip (420..423) -- four lumps, lit tops, shaded feet, dark cracks; the silhouette and its foam rim kept

quay.title: the quay's edge (ARDOR, the S.S. ANNE's pier, THREE ISLAND)
quay.look: dictated: one more course of the paving's running bond, the coping, lit along its arris; the lap below it in small even ripples against the stone, over gbawater's strip

puddle.title: FOUR ISLAND's puddles: their banks
puddle.look: dictated: the bank already ours at 310 -- a lit lip on the grass, a dark bank, a wet foot; one-pixel banks in small stones, symmetric so a bank meets its mirror

doors.title: the sliding doors 0x62 (single) and 0x15B (double)
doors.look: the real choice: the glass (A THE CLEAR PANE, B THE READOUT, C THE MANIFESTATION); the frame and threshold stay; gbadoors re-runs after the write
